messages.text:
The direct probe confirmed the application itself is hydrated and responds; the remaining Playwright failures are from parallel smoke-test timing and pointer interception, especially with the toast and sticky/dock surfaces.

I’m making the smoke test deterministic by running it serially and dispatching the same button events after hydration rather than relying on fragile pointer coordinates.
